hero.label: The Collections
hero.headline: Every Category. One Standard.
hero.subheadline: From Halloween and summer graphics to retro-inspired artwork and fan favourites — every CALLESIL collection is built around one principle: original design, bold color, and wearable art.

collections.name: Halloween Collection
collections.description: Spooky, playful and original graphic tees made for Halloween season.

collections.name: Summer & Ocean Collection
collections.description: Bright, breezy and full of life. Our Summer & Ocean collection captures the energy of warm days and coastal vibes — colorful graphics inspired by the sea, sunshine and everything in between.

collections.name: Retro & Vintage Collection
collections.description: Inspired by the golden eras of art, music and street culture. Our Retro & Vintage collection brings nostalgic graphic design back to life — bold prints, faded palettes and timeless attitude on every tee.

collections.name: Best Sellers
collections.description: The designs our customers keep coming back for. Bold graphics, striking colours and artwork that turns heads — these are the CALLESIL pieces that started it all.

collections.name: More to Come
collections.description: CALLESIL is always creating. New designs, new themes and new collections are always in the works. Follow us on Etsy to be the first to know when new drops arrive.

cta.heading: Ready to shop?
cta.subtext: Browse all available pieces on our Etsy store — including new arrivals, limited drops, and custom order options.
